_provenance.what: ESPN injury-report records — one team block per league, transcribed VERBATIM at the keys the parser reads (same convention as the MLB fixture in test/simulation.test.js: every parse-relevant key/value is byte-equal to the live response; the athlete `links`/`headshot` and team `logos`/`links` noise the parser never reads is omitted).
_provenance.captured_via: Arena page-fetch tool (direct TLS egress is blocked in this sandbox). The live responses are one JSON document per league, `injuries[]` = one entry per team, each with `injuries[]` = one record per player. The first espn-signals workflow run keeps the full raw responses under data/espn-signals/fixtures/raw/.
_provenance.trust_label: ESPN PUBLIC JSON — TRUSTED BUT NOT OFFICIAL. ESPN aggregates team injury designations; it is not a league transaction wire. Every strategy card that reads this archive says so.

injuries.longComment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
injuries.shortComment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
